paper_metadata.title: Transient Liquid Phase Bonding for Ni-base Superalloys, Mar-M247 and IN939

evidence.quote: This paper discusses T LP bonding for Ni-base superalloys Mar-M247 and IN939, which contain many elements to enhance high temperature strength, using filler metals specially designed and produced by rapid solidification.

evidence.quote: When Al less filler metal (F27) was used, Al diffused from the base metal and fine y' precipitated all over the bond. When 4.9% Al was used, the bond region was occupied by condensed y' ... volume fractions of y' were 44% in the former, 82% in the latter and 53% in the base metal.
W addition to filler metal seemed effective to precipitate primary carbides, but large quantities of W might be the cause of a melting point increase.
Ti addition to the filler metal seemed to precipitate a harmful Ti-rich phase at the bond.

attributes.morphology: straight boundary at center of bond

evidence.quote: The 0.1 MPa bond showed a straight boundary at the center, even after the 1503 K, 259.2 ks diffusion heat treatment.
It is considered that when the bonding pressure was small, stable compounds as oxides remained at the surface of the bonds and restricted the boundary movements.
High temperature (1033 K) tensile tests showed that the 0.1 and IO MPa bonded Mar-M247 with F24 were 984 and 950 MPa, respectively.

They were almost the same as those of base metal 907-942 MPa.
Maximum Mar-M247 efficiency 74.5% was obtained when treated at 1503 K for 86.4 ks.

mechanisms.name: transient liquid phase bonding (boron diffusion-induced isothermal solidification)

evidence.quote: the solidifica- tion of the filler metal starts at the interface of the filler metal/ base metal, according to the diffusion of the melting point depressant element B into the base metal, and ends at the center of the bond.

mechanisms.name: yttrium prime precipitation promotion by Al addition

evidence.quote: Al addi- tion to the filler metal promoted the precipitation of y'.
It is considered that the bonding pressure is effective for pushing out such impurities as oxides from the bond or reducing the filler metal thickness, which decreases the heat treatment time.

mechanisms.name: grain boundary strengthening control of stress rupture life

evidence.quote: This might support the concept that grain boundary strength is predominant over the stress rupture property and the transgranular strength is predominant over tensile strength.

mechanisms.name: hot corrosion acceleration by residual Si

evidence.quote: It is considered that corrosion rate difference was due to the Si remaining. Si seemed to cause an undesirable effect on the hot corrosion.
